lines.text: David opens with, "O LORD, You have searched me and known me." The LORD knows when he sits, when he rises, and every word BEFORE it hits his tongue. Too wonderful for David to reach, friend.

Where can David flee from God's presence? Up to the heavens, down in Sheol, rising on the wings of eagles, out by the farthest sea. The LORD is there EVERY time, and even the darkness is as light to Him.

wrong_details.wrong: rising on the wings of eagles
wrong_details.true: rising on the wings of the dawn

lines.text: The LORD knit David together in his mother's womb, so David praises Him: fearfully and wonderfully made! And all his days were written in God's book before one of them came to be.
God's thoughts are precious and vast. If David tried to count them, they'd outnumber the stars in the sky, and when he wakes up, he's still with God.

David wants the bloodthirsty men away from him and counts God's enemies as his own. Then he turns the search on HIMSELF: "Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns." Then he asks God to lead him in the way everlasting.
